benchmark_name: PD-MCI Baseline Tabular Deep Learning & Foundation Model Benchmark

protocol.primary_metric: AUPRC (average precision, non-interpolated) on the locked test set; model comparisons use the paired participant-level bootstrap Delta AUPRC versus LR
protocol.secondary_metrics: Delta AUROC and Delta Brier versus LR, calibration slope and intercept, decision curve analysis. No correction for multiple comparisons; an isolated nominally significant difference is reported as exploratory, not as evidence that a model is better.
protocol.leakage_prevention: In-fold standardization on training folds; test set transformed using whole training set scaler
protocol.early_stopping: XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, RealMLP and TabM use a stratified 10% split of the rows they are trained on; scored rows are never used for early stopping. Other models are fit on all training rows.
protocol.class_imbalance: No class weighting or resampling in any model, so predicted probabilities stay on the risk scale (van den Goorbergh et al., JAMIA 2022).
protocol.threshold: Youden threshold from pooled training out-of-fold predictions
protocol.quick_test: --quick-test evaluates on a stratified 30% split of the training set and never uses the locked test set

tuning.not_tuned: LR keeps its own pipeline (LASSO lambda chosen by 10-fold CV AUPRC with the 1SE rule); the pretrained foundation models use their default zero-shot settings.
tuning.objective: Mean AUPRC over the 5 training-set CV folds (same folds, in-fold standardization and inner early-stopping split as the benchmark CV), maximized
tuning.search_spaces: Defined in step_15_tuning.py (search_space function); their source code is part of the tuning fingerprint
tuning.search_space_revision: 2 (2026-09-29). Round 1 (training set only; results in step_15_tuning_round1/) found top trials clustered at artificial range limits, so those ranges were widened once and the GBDT tree cap raised from 1000 to 5000; all 14 model-track combinations were re-tuned. A parameter still at a range limit after round 2 is accepted (no further widening).

known_deviations: Inputs are the step 08 imputed matrices (training-set medians/modes estimated on the full training set), so imputation is not repeated inside CV folds; missingness is 0-8% per feature.
The 7-feature track uses features selected by LASSO on the full training set, so its CV estimates are optimistic; its test-set evaluation is unaffected.

Hyperparameters are tuned on the same training-set CV folds that give the out-of-fold predictions used for the Youden threshold, so CV metrics of tuned models are optimistic; the test-set evaluation is unaffected.

2026-09-27: before the protocol fixes in benchmark config v1.1.1, the locked test set was evaluated twice by the pre-fix code: a --quick-test run (19:19, under-trained smoke-test settings) and a full run of both tracks (19:34-19:38, committed in 52b0f7d; plain LR on all inputs, TabPFN v2 weights, TabFM with 100 context rows, early stopping on the scored CV fold). The v1.1.1 changes come from a code review of methodological defects (early-stopping leakage, 90% final fits, LR comparator, silent failures, test-set use by quick tests) and from pre-specified choices (TabPFN v2.5, TabFM with all rows); no model, hyperparameter or checkpoint was chosen from those test-set results. Both pre-fix runs are superseded and must not be reported as benchmark results.

2026-09-29 (v1.4): the v1.2 protocol (config 1.2.0) was evaluated once on the locked test set (v1.2 release). v1.4 changes the protocol after those results were seen: the 7-feature track becomes primary (clinical interpretability; 28 features did not improve any model in v1.2) and the 28-feature track a sensitivity analysis; AUPRC becomes the pre-specified primary metric (v1.2 named none); TabPFN v2.5 is dropped (its v1.2 results matched v3.5); SVM, RF, LightGBM and RealMLP are added; all models trained from scratch are tuned instead of using fixed settings; the sex subgroup analysis is dropped. The locked test set will be evaluated a second time with the v1.4 protocol.

LR.pipeline: LASSO selection (10-fold stratified CV, AUPRC, 1SE rule) -> unpenalized LR -> bootstrap uniform shrinkage with re-estimated intercept, refit inside every training fold

LR_plain.display_name: Logistic Regression on all inputs (supplementary, not in default run)

TabPFN.checkpoint: tabpfn-v3.5-20260909.safetensors (Hugging Face Prior-Labs/tabpfn_3_5, gated; local file only; base model, not the API-only Thinking variant)
